annotations.description: On Turn 1 with no lands in play, the player passed without playing a land or any spell. They had Watery Grave in hand which could enter untapped (paying 2 life) to cast either Stormchaser's Talent (creating a prowess Otter token) or Spyglass Siren (a 1/1 flyer + Map token). Missing the Turn 1 land drop puts them an entire turn behind on mana development.
